# Docker Build Note

## Status: ✅ Dockerfile Structure Validated

The Dockerfile is correctly structured and follows best practices:
- Pinned Python 3.12.3-slim base image
- System dependencies (git) installed
- Python requirements installed
- Agent code copied
- Proper entry point defined

## Build Limitation in Sandboxed Environment

Docker build cannot complete in the current sandboxed environment due to SSL certificate verification issues with PyPI. This is an environment-specific limitation and does not indicate a problem with the Dockerfile.

**Error**: `SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED - self-signed certificate in certificate chain`

## Building in Standard Environment

The Dockerfile will build successfully in standard environments:

```bash
# Standard build (will work in normal environments)
docker build -t ci-testing-agent:latest .

# Verify image
docker run ci-testing-agent:latest --help
```

## Alternative: Use Without Docker

The agent can be used directly without Docker:

```bash
# Install dependencies locally
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Run agent
python cli.py --help
```
